reconstruction.summary: Python C-API wrapper that decodes a binary trader helper request blob. Takes one argument (bytes), parses it into timestamp bytes, a list of code bytes, and a data buffer of doubles, and returns an outer tuple (bytes_ts, inner_tuple) where inner_tuple = (list_of_bytes_codes, bytes_buffer). Similar to pinot_decode_slice_helper but for trader helper request data.
reconstruction.behavioral_notes: 1) Takes a single Python bytes object argument via PyArg_ParseTuple format "O". 2) Parses the binary blob: extracts timestamp bytes (8 bytes), then a list of code bytes (fixed-length byte strings), then a data buffer of doubles (8 bytes each). 3) Returns outer tuple: (bytes_ts, inner_tuple). 4) inner_tuple = (PyList of bytes codes, PyBytes of doubles buffer). 5) Similar structure to pinot_decode_slice_helper but the binary format may differ (trader helper request vs slice data). 6) Python side consumes decoded[1][1] as np.double buffer, decoded[1][0] as code list, decoded[0] as ts.
